import socket
import ssl

# Create a socket connection
sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
sock.settimeout(10)
sock.connect(('en.wikipedia.org', 443))

# Wrap with SSL
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
ctx.check_hostname = False
ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
ssock = ctx.wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname='en.wikipedia.org')

# Send request
request = b"GET /w/api.php?action=query&titles=Less+Deep+Inside+Keeps&prop=extracts&format=json HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: en.wikipedia.org\r\nUser-Agent: Python/1.0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
ssock.sendall(request)

# Receive response
response = b""
while True:
    chunk = ssock.recv(4096)
    if not chunk:
        break
    response += chunk

print(response.decode())
ssock.close()
sock.close()
"}

import socket
import ssl
import json

def get_wikipedia_data():
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.settimeout(10)
    sock.connect(('en.wikipedia.org', 443))
    
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    ctx.check_hostname = False
    ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
    ssock = ctx.wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname='en.wikipedia.org')
    
    request = b"GET /w/api.php?action=query&titles=Less+Deep+Inside+Keeps&prop=extracts&format=json HTTP/1.1\r\n"
    request += b"Host: en.wikipedia.org\r\n"
    request += b"User-Agent: Python/1.0\r\n"
    request += b"Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
    
    ssock.sendall(request)
    
    response = b""
    while True:
        try:
            chunk = ssock.recv(4096)
            if not chunk:
                break
            response += chunk
        except socket.timeout:
            break
    
    ssock.close()
    sock.close()
    
    # Extract JSON from response
    text = response.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
    json_start = text.find('{')
    json_end = text.rfind('}') + 1
    if json_start != -1 and json_end != 0:
        json_str = text[json_start:json_end]
        try:
            data = json.loads(json_str)
            print(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            print(f"JSON parse error: {e}")
            print(text)
    else:
        print(text)

get_wikipedia_data()
"}
